notes.title: Thanks for playing our demo!
notes.content:
Hey horror fans! 

We just wanted to say a big thanks to everyone who checked out the A.I.L.A demo, and also to those of you who left a review ([b]94% Very Positive out of 470![/b]). This is the second horror game we've worked on but it still feels just as special to read through all your kind words. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157523/aad4b8703f3a950aaff44ab6d7bef684cbe06480.gif[/img]

[h3][b]The A.I.L.A demo is leaving Steam (for now...)[/b][/h3]

The demo is coming down today while we continue to work on the full game and implement some of your feedback. We may bring the demo back at some point, but for now it's all about the final stretch to launch!

[b][h3][b]When is A.I.L.A releasing?[/b] [/h3][/b]

We know many of you are eager for a release date, and believe me, we're eager to announce one! There's still some polishes and improvements that need doing before we're able to lock down a date for certain, but it will be this year, and we're hoping to be able to let you know within the next month or two! 

Thanks again for all your support!

Pulsatrix

notes.title: Play A.I.L.A today!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

It brings us heaps of excitement to finally announce... The A.I.L.A demo is ready to download! 

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3804480/AILA_Demo/]Head here to play.[/url][/b]

[h3][b]Can you survive the Impossible House?[/b] [/h3]

With this [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3804480/AILA_Demo/]new demo[/url] you'll be thrown into the [b]first scenario[/b] of the game, and you'll find yourself waking up in a strange house (and in a pretty grim situation!) with no idea where you are. Things look a little strange, nothing makes sense, and you get the feeling you're not alone... [b]Will you be able to escape[/b]? 

Expect puzzles, unsettling moments, and some teeth-gritting encounters. Good luck! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157523/809793b4bcddde8f1af6b829273179030d76dc6a.gif[/img]

Launching our demo has been a huge goal of ours, and we can't wait to hear how you get on. If you do give it a go, [b]we'd really appreciate it if you could leave us a review[/b]. This will help us with visibility so more horror gamers can discover AI.L.A. Thank you! 

[h3][b]We're part of Tiny Teams! [/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157523/60fed831f6d1b53caff80903bb3363d172ffca6c.jpg[/img]

Our demo will be playable as part of the Tiny Teams event, but we might decide to keep it live for a little while after the event! There's loads of great titles being showcased, so do check out the Steam page to find your next favourite game. 

Talk soon! 

Pulsatrix

notes.title: A.I.L.A: Developer Commentary & Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

A.I.L.A is releasing this year and we're hard at work bug fixing and polishing! It's been so much fun working on our second horror game, and really rewarding seeing how far we've come since launching [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1298140/Fobia__St_Dinfna_Hotel/][b]Fobia - St. Dinfna Hotel [/b][/url]back in 2022. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157523/62de66ae4edafaca98a1341653d92d33a32cf36b.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Check out our latest dev commentary! [/b][/h3]

As some of you might know, [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCJ8GQ_SNb-33m_BluT4TTlw][b]MaxMRM[/b][/url] is our Creative Director, and he's narrated our dev commentary trailer. This is a deep dive into what to expect from A.I.L.A, and gives a closer look at the story and the game's main character, Samuel. There's also some unseen before gameplay footage, so it's worth watching if you're eager to see more of what we've been creating!

[previewyoutube=e4vjU3yaCgE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]New screenshots [/b][/h3]

We've also taken some new screenshots which we wanted to share. These show some of the different scenarios Samuel encounters. A.I.L.A is a psychological horror game, but you'll find there's definitely elements of survival and threats throughout!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157523/ec693217d4b0c233b73ed098f0b58209e1346cdf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157523/bbd0d7bccdcf1aa7832444b0fd0d88f7072b2ff8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157523/93c1fb547d34dac37208a32d7c11bc3add28fa59.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157523/d4b1610b6ebfa0c96a073a9c3d4dfa5cb57efe01.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Ask us anything! [/b][/h3]

Do you have any questions about A.I.L.A? Would you like to know more about our development journey or what's coming to the game? Let us know in the comments and we'll work on a Q&A. 

Thanks so much for reading! 

Pulsatrix Studios
